SELECT 
    s.city,
    t.member_id,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
FROM trip t
JOIN station s ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
GROUP BY s.city, t.member_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(trip_cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) as trip_cnt
        FROM trip t2
        JOIN station s2 ON t2.start_station_id = s2.station_id
        WHERE s2.city = s.city
        GROUP BY t2.member_id
    )
)
ORDER BY s.city, t.member_id;
